page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a centred heading and rule titles set apart. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.head: Sexta Regula.
main_text.p: Filij aut filiæ, ex pluribus fratribus aut sororibus n[?]ati,natæve,quamvis numero inæquales sint, patruo tamen defuncto, non in stirpes (ut quidam veterum voluerunt) sed in capita succedunt. Secundum Baldum & Salycetum in d.Auth. cessante. Et per Constitutionem Caroli Quinti Imperatoris in Comitiis Spirensibus, Anno 1529. promulgatam.Vide Schneidevvinum.
main_text.head: Septima Regula[?]
main_text.p: Post fratres fratrumq; filios, vocantur ad successionem reliqui collaterales, quicunq; in gradu sunt proximiores, remotioribus exclusis: ita quòd infallibiliter semper prior in gradu, sit potior in successione, & pares in gradu, pariter admittantur in capita, secundum numerum personarum, non in stirpes. Authen. post fratres.la.2. C. de legitimis hæredibus. Obseruandum, quòd semper in computatione graduum descendentes ex fratre ex altero tantum latere sint remotiores, quàm descendentes à fatre[?], ex utroq; parente conjuncti, inquit Schneidevvinus.
main_text.head: Sequentes Regulæ de Collateralium naturalium tantum successione observentur.
Prima Regula[?]
main_text.p: Fratres naturales tantùm, paterna origine conjuncti, sibi invicem non succedunt: quia nulla inter eos agnatio, vel cognatio de jure intercedit. §. vulgò quæsitos. inst. de successione cognator.
main_text.head: Secunda Regula[?]
main_text.p: Fratres naturales tantùm, respectu maternæ lineæ conjuncti sibi invicem succedere queunt. l.1. & l. si-purius.ff. unde cognati.

page.notes: The stray mark at the bottom centre is a printer's ornament or show-through, not text, and is left out. "Septima Regula", "Prima Regula" and "Secunda Regula" are printed with an ornamented R whose flourish looks like a question mark; marked [?]. "n[?]ati" is partly lost at the left edge of the line. "fatre" appears as printed; the first letter is damaged and may be "p". "Schneidevvinum" is kept as printed. The rule titles are treated as level 3 headings, the centred title above the rules as level 2.
